findings.passage: HB 79, the Firearm Safe Handling and Secure Storage Tax Credit Act, encourages responsible gun ownership by offering tax credits for training and safes. It also creates a tax holiday for gun-related purchases.
findings.note: End-of-session column under his name (he signs as Senate Finance chair), published on a Rome radio station's site. He lists HB 79 among tax measures the Senate passed and describes it as encouraging responsible gun ownership through tax credits and a tax holiday. He does not say how he voted or address any ban, permit or background-check rule.
subjects: tax credit for gun safes and training
gun sales tax holiday
gun safety laws in general

findings.passage: Additionally, it updates Georgia’s juvenile code to bring serious school-related crimes, like terroristic threats or acts, under the jurisdiction of superior courts, strengthens penalties for firearm-related offenses committed by minors, and establishes consequences for disrupting schools, buses, or bus stops.
findings.note: Weekly column under his name describing HB 268 (school safety), of which he says he hopes to see it on the Senate floor. The bill's text, as he summarises it, stiffens penalties for firearm offences by minors. He names no other gun measure.
